rule: Keep the separate Feature agent and Critic only if the one-agent design is worse on paired folds: the 95% CI of the per-fold PR-AUC difference (one agent minus three agents, both with definitions; each fold first averaged over runs) lies entirely below 0. Otherwise fold them into one agent.
caveat: Folds from repeated CV are correlated, so this CI is too narrow; that makes 'worse' easier to declare. A decision to keep separate agents is therefore weaker than the CI suggests.
